name: Broccoli Cheddar Rice Skillet
description: A simple comfort-food skillet with rice, broccoli, cheddar, and onion.

instructions.text: Set out a saucepan with a lid and a large nonstick skillet with a lid. Use 1 cup dry long-grain white rice. Cook it with the water amount and timing on the package, typically 2 cups water and 15–20 minutes on low heat after bringing to a boil. Rest covered off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Wash 2 cups broccoli and cut it into florets about 1 inch across. If using the optional 1/2 onion, peel it and chop into pieces about 1/4 inch across. Grate 1 cup cheddar.

If using onion, put it in the skillet with 2 tablespoons water over medium heat. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until softened. Add more water 1 tablespoon at a time if the pan dries before it softens.

Add the broccoli and 1/4 cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat for 4–6 minutes until a fork pierces the stems with slight resistance. Carefully lift the lid away from your face. If still hard, cover and cook another 1–2 minutes.
Add all the cooked rice and stir gently for 1–2 minutes until hot throughout. If the mixture sticks, reduce heat and add 1 tablespoon water.
Turn the heat to low. Sprinkle in the 1 cup cheddar in 3 additions, stirring after each until melted, about 1–2 minutes total. Turn off the heat. Divide among 3 bowls and serve warm.

source.originalInstructions: Saute onion, add broccoli and cooked rice, then fold in cheddar until melted.
